messages:
claire zhou: Hi everyone! Claire here — first day on Growth Eng. I'm the unofficial sticker archivist & bring-your-own-zine enthusiast. Hybrid SF. Desk on 7F by the big window. I also have an overwatered philodendron named 'Mochi'. Matcha lover. Happy to trade stickers or lunchtime comic recs. :wave:
noor patel: Welcome Claire! :wave: Where's your sticker stash? I'm partial to tiny puns.
claire zhou: it's a tote bag under my desk with a 'space ramen' and a 'debugging cat' — open to trades. Also I baked sesame cookies today if anyone's free to drop by around 3.
devon lee: I'll bring some enamel pins to trade :sparkles: also FYI we have a sticker board by the kitchenette — put a 'new hire' sticker so people know.
sasha kim: Mochi pics??? :heart_eyes: Also if the plant needs rescuing I owe a green thumb. Can swing by and water.
welcome-bot: Welcome package delivered to 7F desk! :package: Onboarding checklist updated.
jamie ortiz: Lunch crew heading to the taco stand at 12:30 if you want to join. Also very excited about sesame cookies.
claire zhou: tacos & cookies yes please. thanks for the warm welcome! happy to DM folks about sticker trades. :sparkling_heart:
noor patel: quick q — into synth / vinyl? there's a rooftop vinyl swap on Fridays.
claire zhou: huge yes. see you Friday rooftop :vinyl:
